verdict.rationale: Marqeta is a payments API platform, not an AI agent/assistant, so 'plugging MCP servers into it so it can use their tools' is a category error—Marqeta has no agent interface acting as an MCP client. The only MCP-related evidence shows the reverse: Marqeta ships its own MCP server for external AI agents to consume (marqeta-docs-11, marqeta-probe-4), which is a different axis.
